title: Trusted boundary: on an operator-verified server, a descriptor-only tool is usable; the same tool on an unverified boundary is denied outright
note: Trust anchor = operator verification of the server boundary (ServerCard.operatorVerified, a DECLARED operator fact): the descriptor-only tool needs no profile on a verified boundary. The violating twin runs in P3b (separate fixture, because the gateway option differs): identical tool, identical args, unverified boundary + unprofiledToolPolicy deny → hard deny.
